title: HeroQuest
subtitle: Classic Fantasy Dungeon Crawl Adventure Campaign
tagline: Answer Mentor's call, step into the torchlit depths, and battle the forces of Zargon across 14 perilous quests.
loreSummary: The dark forces of Dread threaten the Empire. Guided by the wise sage Mentor, four valiant heroes—the Barbarian, Dwarf, Elf, and Wizard—descend into subterranean dungeons to battle orcs, mummies, and chaos sorcerers, earning gold to buy legendary artifacts between adventures.
keyFeatures: The legendary, pioneering fantasy dungeon crawl board game originally created by Stephen Baker
Progressive 14-quest core campaign book following the gathering of the heroes to the Witch Lord
Playable 1-vs-many with a Zargon player or fully cooperatively via the official companion app
Detailed 3D furniture, doors, treasure chests, and iconic plastic miniature monsters

heroquest_core_fourteen_quests.name: The Gathering of the Heroes (All 14 Quests)
heroquest_core_fourteen_quests.description: The complete original 14-quest adventure book campaign from The Trial to the final confrontation in Barak Tor.

heroquest_introductory_trial.name: The Trial of the Champions (Quests 1–4)
heroquest_introductory_trial.description: An introductory 4-quest journey mastering combat, dungeon movement, and recovering Prince Magnus' gold.

heroquest_master_mentor.name: Champion of the Realm (All 14 Quests & Mythic Scenarios)
heroquest_master_mentor.description: An exhaustive dungeon crawl marathon including core quests and bonus mythic challenges at peak difficulty.

milestones.title: The Trial
milestones.description: Stepping through the heavy dungeon doorway to battle Orcs and Goblins and survive your first deadly labyrinth.

milestones.title: Prince Magnus' Gold
milestones.description: Infiltrating subterranean catacombs to recover stolen royal gold chests from Chaos warriors.

milestones.title: The Fire Mage
milestones.description: Confronting the renegade pyromancer Balur within his subterranean magma fortress before he unleashes doom.

milestones.title: Bastion of Chaos
milestones.description: Breaching the outer sanctum of the Dread sorcerers and recovering the ancient Spirit Blade.

milestones.title: Return to Barak Tor
milestones.phase: Act V - The Witch Lord's Doom
milestones.description: Unleashing the Spirit Blade against the undead Witch Lord to save Mentor and the realm of the Empire.
